card.name: Partway through drug names in interaction lists
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle or end of a drug or herb name, or the word right after a drug name, in drug interaction sections. Examples are St. John's w|ort, atazanav|ir, Omnisc|an and Thiabendazole Decre|ases.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Fires on a middle or ending piece of a drug or herb name in an example list.

modes.label: Word after a drug name
modes.description: Fires on the first piece of a word that follows a drug name in an interaction entry.
